verses.en: LORD, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.
verses.pt: Foste favorável, ó SENHOR, à tua terra; restauraste Jacó de seu infortúnio.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of the sons of Korah.> Lord, you were good to your land: changing the fate of Jacob.

verses.en: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.
verses.pt: Perdoaste a perversidade de teu povo; encobriste todos os seus pecados. (Selá)
verses.en_web: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: The wrongdoing of your people had forgiveness; all their sin had been covered. (Selah.)

verses.en: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.
verses.pt: Removeste toda a tua indignação; do ardor de tua ira te desviaste.
verses.en_web: You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.
verses.en_bbe: You were no longer angry: you were turned from the heat of your wrath.

verses.en: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.
verses.pt: Restaura-nos, ó Deus de nossa salvação; e cessa tua ira de sobre nós.
verses.en_web: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.
verses.en_bbe: Come back to us, O God of our salvation, and be angry with us no longer.

verses.en: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?
verses.pt: Acaso estarás irado contra nós para sempre? Estenderás a tua ira de geração em geração?
verses.en_web: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?
verses.en_bbe: Will you go on being angry with us for ever? will you keep your wrath against us through all the long generations?

verses.en: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
verses.pt: Não voltará a dar-nos vida, para que o teu povo se alegre em ti?
verses.en_web: Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?
verses.en_bbe: Will you not give us life again, so that your people may be glad in you?

verses.en: Shew us thy mercy, O LORD, and grant us thy salvation.
verses.pt: Mostra-nos tua bondade, SENHOR, e dá para nós tua salvação.
verses.en_web: Show us your loving kindness, Yahweh. Grant us your salvation.
verses.en_bbe: Let us see your mercy, O Lord, and give us your salvation.

verses.en: I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.
verses.pt: Escutarei o que o Deus, o SENHOR, falar, pois ele falará de paz ao seu povo, e aos seus santos, contanto que não voltem à loucura.
verses.en_web: I will hear what God, Yahweh, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.
verses.en_bbe: I will give ear to the voice of the Lord; for he will say words of peace to his people and to his saints; but let them not go back to their foolish ways.

verses.en: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.
verses.pt: Certamente sua salvação está perto daqueles que o temem, para que a glória habite em nossa terra.
verses.en_web: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, his salvation is near to his worshippers; so that glory may be in our land.

verses.en: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
verses.pt: A bondade e a verdade se encontrarão; a justiça e a paz se beijarão.
verses.en_web: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
verses.en_bbe: Mercy and faith have come together; righteousness and peace have given one another a kiss.

verses.en: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.
verses.pt: A verdade brotará da terra, e a justiça olhará desde os céus.
verses.en_web: Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.
verses.en_bbe: Faith comes up from the earth like a plant; righteousness is looking down from heaven.

verses.en: Yea, the LORD shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.
verses.pt: E o SENHOR também dará o bem; e a nossa terra dará o seu fruto.
verses.en_web: Yes, Yahweh will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will give what is good; and our land will give its increase.

verses.en: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.
verses.pt: A justiça irá adiante dele, e ele nos porá no caminho de seus passos. Oração de Davi:
verses.en_web: Righteousness goes before him, And prepares the way for his steps.
verses.en_bbe: Righteousness will go before him, making a way for his footsteps.
